name: Dr. Ines Quiroga
leaveLine: I am not sure this is my century any more. I am not sure it is anyone's.
joinLine: She wrote four of the five models they pooled, and she has been trying to get the weights published since the afternoon they closed them.
signature: Blueprint: puts a machine of her own on the field

bio: Founding engineer at Meridian and the author of four of the five models they pooled in 2031. She argued for open weights in the room where it was decided, lost the vote seven to two, and has never once stopped saying so.
